input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: We construct a large-scale multimodal dataset that pairs single-cell gene expression profiles with natural language descriptions to enable cross-modal learning between genomic data and biological knowledge.
transformation_chain_verbatim: select 1,000,000 cells from 7,331 donors, spanning 783 cell types, 347 tissue types, and 128 disease conditions
generate structured text descriptions by combining metadata annotations with functional context
enrich cell type information using OBO Cell Ontology definitions
capture biological processes through pathway activity analysis with pySCENIC applied to 34 curated MSigDB Hallmark pathways
identify the two most enriched pathways and translate them into human-readable descriptions of active biological processes
transformation_chain_normalized: sample 1,000,000 cells across donors and categories
generate structured text descriptions from metadata and functional context
enrich cell-type information with Cell Ontology definitions
translate top pathways into human-readable descriptions
